glosses: etwas in seinem Ausmaß begrenzen; jemanden in seinen Möglichkeiten einschränken

examples.text: Eine immer wieder vorgebrachte Idee ist, die Anzahl der Beamten zu restringieren.

translations.source_sense_description: bildungssprachlich: etwas in seinem Ausmaß begrenzen; jemanden in seinen Möglichkeiten einschränken

glosses: To restrain within boundaries; to limit; to confine

examples.text: After suffering diahrroea, the patient was restricted to a diet of rice, cold meat, and yoghurt.
It was no less than Valencia deserved after dominating possession in the final 20 minutes although Chelsea defended resolutely and restricted the Spanish side to shooting from long range.

glosses: To consider (a function) as defined on a subset of its original domain.

examples.text: If we restrict sine to #92;left#91;-#92;frac#92;pi2,#92;frac#92;pi2#92;right#93;, we can define its inverse.
